items.where: Crafted with Engineering (SAF-T Emergency Ripper: Everlook).

items.where: Crafted with Engineering (EZ and SAF Field Transporter: Mt. Hyjal).

stats: “May the Holy Light protect us on our expedition to the frozen north.”

items.name: Aegwynn's Silver Coin
stats: “I really wish you mages would get your heads out from inside your own... books.”

items.name: Alleria's Silver Coin
stats: “May my sisters realize their full potential, the name Windrunner known as a result of their deeds.”

items.name: Antonidas' Silver Coin
stats: “Grant me the strength to accept the things that I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference.”

items.name: Arcanist Doan's Silver Coin
stats: “Oh, why won't you notice me? Abbendis, I would follow you anywhere. I wish you would notice me...”

items.name: Fandral Staghelm's Silver Coin
stats: “I pray that when the time comes, I will have the strength to thwart the forces beyond the gate.”

items.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque's Silver Coin
stats: “How does this fountain even work? I wonder if I could make one.”

items.name: Khadgar's Silver Coin
stats: “Turalyon and Alleria, wherever you are, may you be well.”

items.name: King Terenas Menethil's Silver Coin
stats: “May my son Arthas always act in the best interest of his people.”

items.name: Medivh's Silver Coin
stats: “<You sense the ringing of three tones in your head, the third barely audible under the others' din.>”

items.name: Prince Magni Bronzebeard's Silver Coin
stats: “I hope that my father and brothers outlive me. I'll not make much of a king.”

items.name: Anduin Wrynn's Gold Coin
stats: “I wish I would grow up, it feels like I've been 10 for years.”

items.name: Uther Lightbringer's Gold Coin
stats: “Young Arthas must learn patience to temper his power. I will pray that he one day learns how to lead with care rather than force.”

items.name: Arthas' Gold Coin
stats: “Already, I've a kingdom in my prospects, a land to rule. What to ask for? Perhaps a frozen scone...”

items.name: Arugal's Gold Coin
stats: “I wish someday to retire to my own tidy little estate, with a bunch of pet dogs to keep me company.”

items.name: Kel'Thuzad's Gold Coin
stats: “Sometimes... I wish someone would come along and just give me a big, long hug.”

items.name: Lady Jaina Proudmoore's Gold Coin
stats: “Arthas, my love, please come back to me.”

items.name: Lady Katrana Prestor's Gold Coin
stats: “Listen, little wishing fountain. You'll give me all your power if you know what's good for you.”

items.name: Sylvanas Windrunner's Gold Coin
stats: “I hope my sisters and I can grow up and get married together. This coin appears to be very old.”

items.name: Tirion Fordring's Gold Coin
stats: “It is my wish that my dear Taelan will grow strong enough to defend the people he cares for.”

items.name: Archimonde's Gold Coin
stats: “I wish to know how you survived my wrath, little fountain.”

items.name: Valdrus Blackthorne's Gold Coin
stats: “Explain my dreams, little fountain. Why must I always be viewing my kin from above and moving them like pawns?”

items.name: Umbrinoth's Gold Coin
stats: “It seems my moonlighting days as a postal worker are coming to an end.”

items.name: Thrall's Gold Coin
stats: “Grom, may you rest well, old friend.”

items.name: Sonya Darkhallow's Gold Coin
stats: “This doesn't make sense. Why am I putting a coin in a fountain?”

items.name: Zarla Ober's Gold Coin
stats: “The amount of coins shining in the pool. Maybe no one will notice if I take just one.”

items.name: A Footman's Copper Coin
stats: “Wish I had that cousin of mine's duty to do nothing more than lug wood around carelessly...”

items.name: Vargoth's Copper Coin
stats: “I wish Captain Sanders would hurry up with my shipment of wine.”

items.name: Ansirem's Copper Coin
stats: “I wish for happiness and acceptance for my daughter. She feels so out of place here...”

items.name: Attumen's Copper Coin
stats: “Can I have a more comfortable saddle? My hindquarters ache.”

items.name: Danath's Copper Coin
stats: “I hope a troll dies, right... NOW.”

items.name: Elling Trias' Copper Coin
stats: “Being a rogue is hard work. Someday I hope to pursue my life's one true passion...”

items.name: Falstad Wildhammer's Copper Coin
stats: “I hope I end up in another book eventually.”

items.name: Inigo's Copper Coin
stats: “I wish I had my father back...”

items.name: Squire Rowan's Copper Coin
stats: “I wish people would stop knocking my toys off the shelf.”

items.name: Rath'mael's Copper Coin
stats: “I could have used this copper for something productive. Perhaps something with string and a machine.”

items.name: Ofalo's Copper Coin
stats: “How does a tavern run out of ale!”

items.name: Sair's Copper Coin
stats: “I miss my sword and shield. I feel so naked without my sword and shield.”

items.name: Rhonin's Gold Coin
stats: “Here you go, Nozdormu. What was I supposed to do after this?”

items.name: Elaadrin Evengale's Silver Coin
stats: “How do I prove they copied us with this fountain?”
